record.dic_text:
05653 `Abda' {ab-daw'}

源自 05647; 陽性專有名詞 人名

AV - Abda 2; 2

亞比大 或 押大 = "耶和華的僕人"
1) 亞多尼蘭的父親
2) 利未人沙母亞的兒子; 又稱作"俄巴底" (#尼 11:17; 代上9:16|)
record.edic_text:
05653 `Abda' {ab-daw'}

from 05647;; n pr m

AV - Abda 2; 2

Abda = "servant of Jehovah"
1) father of Adoniram
2) a Levite, son of Shammua; also called 'Obadiah'
